adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the email notification step is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests); } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`, which (a) discards the caught `err` and (b) uses `console.log` without any structured logging or propagation. This is a real, diff-grounded reliability/observability issue: guests can be added successfully while notifications fail silently and become hard to diagnose. However, the core mutation (adding guests / updating calendar) still succeeds, so it’s not a strictly verifiable functional defect from the diff alone.
